BC_description: In ember-qunit, explicit calls to loadTests and setupEmberOnerrorValidation are now required in test setup code, whereas they were previously handled automatically by the start function. This change breaks client projects that rely on the automatic behavior, as tests may not load or onerror validation may not be set up without these explicit calls.
Adaptation_method: Update your test-helper.js file to explicitly call loadTests and setupEmberOnerrorValidation before calling start. For example: import { loadTests } from 'ember-qunit/test-loader'; import { start, setupEmberOnerrorValidation } from 'ember-qunit'; setupEmberOnerrorValidation(); loadTests(); start();
